scope.mixed_rank: Existing boundary-disjoint adjacent irreducible root sheaves in a Rains heart, q nontorsion, H=-K nef, H^2>0, exceptional structure line bundle. The proof does not assume derived full faithfulness.
scope.global_comparison: Only the specified Rains gluing from a smooth genuine classical del Pezzo S, a smooth anticanonical elliptic E, and q in Pic^0(E). No order restriction on q or the induced boundary translation. This is not a statement that different q give equivalent categories.
scope.global_tilt: The same gluing, with H nef in the chosen Rains heart. The full-heart torsion pair is defined by H^1 Phi and H^0 Phi. Its restriction to Z uses q nontorsion and the established Serre property.
scope.affine_quotient: The actual +2/-1 adjacent root example in this specified gluing; derived comparison and central localization identify the relevant ambient Ext. Generator coefficients in the original elliptic presentation remain uncomputed.

claims.general_connecting_rank: For indices p>0,-n<0, the nonsplit extension P has rank delta=min(p,n), h0=max(p-n,0), h1=max(n-p,0). For p>n its rank-one torsion-free kernel has chi(L,L)=3-2(p-n), and is a line bundle precisely when p-n=1.
claims.finite_length_category: The source two-root Serre category is mod_fd Pi(A2). For vertex dimensions a,b and t=rank(x), h0=pa-min(p,n)t, h1=nb-min(p,n)t. Both unequal-index chambers give the displayed local torsion pairs; balanced indices would kill P but cannot occur for a genuine avatar.
claims.derived_comparison_audit: The companion manuscript's existing all-q comparison was checked through Ind-orbit generation, nonzero boundary trace, finiteness in both order cases, and source saturation. Its proof is rewritten with explicit inputs in resonance_global_heart.tex. This is an internal mathematical audit, not external peer review or formal verification.
claims.global_HRS: Phi has amplitude [0,1] on the entire chosen Rains heart. The anticanonical heart pulls back to <F[1],T>. For nontorsion q, the same torsion pair restricts to all Z with T=ker Ext1(e,-) and F=ker Hom(e,-).
claims.characters: In the +2/-1 example, W and U are distinct one-dimensional characters and 0->W->V->U->0 is nonsplit. The image on V is the full triangular two-by-two algebra, and Hom_A(V,U)=k.
claims.finite_quotient: The reverse nonsplit extension Vprime exists, and A/Ann(V plus Vprime) is Pi(A2), of dimension four and radical-square zero. The quotient is not a homological epimorphism.
claims.local_reflection: The two new character root classes are alpha+beta and -beta, so the numerical change (2,-1)->(1,1) is the beta Weyl reflection. Not a description of the full E6 heart by one reflection.
claims.retained_results: Existing sign trichotomy, degree 1-6 maximal numerical resonance density, irreducible-root uniqueness, Dynkin zigzag Ext, and fixed-category framed formality results are retained. These are not claims of full nc-moduli component coverage.
remaining: Explicit values of the original elliptic algebra generators under the characters and off-diagonal cocycles
Generators for the kernel of the displayed affine quotient
The full E6 off-boundary affine action
Singular elliptic boundary, weak avatar, and non-locally-free gluing extensions
safeguards: Irreducibility alone does not imply simplicity; the proof uses nontorsion q and boundary-disjointness.
The arbitrary-index rank proof uses Corollary 10.12 for rank-one torsion-free sheaves, not an unjustified line-bundle claim.
Internal Ext in mod_fd Pi(A2) is periodic and is not ambient Ext in the Rains or affine category.
The comparison is not inferred merely from equality of graded Ext dimensions; a nonzero trace is tracked by the actual functor.
No claim of full target smoothness is used to prove essential surjectivity; source saturation supplies the adjoint.
